name: AI Sales Trainer
tagline: Practice B2B and retail sales conversations with AI customers
description: AI Sales Trainer by Sandwich Consulting helps B2B and retail sales teams rehearse conversations with simulated AI customers. Practice discovery, objection handling and upcoming meetings, then review feedback and use a skills roadmap to plan the next session. Practice is available in English, German, French, Spanish and Russian. Access is currently free, with no announced end date.
